intro: Armenian outlets highlight Prime Minister Pashinyan's emphasis on repatriation as the ultimate goal of diaspora relations, the opening of the Third Global Armenian Summit, and ongoing political tensions surrounding the Shaki border incident and the detention of businessman Samvel Karapetyan. Progress toward EU visa liberalization and potential accession, as well as ANCA-endorsed victories in U.S. midterms, also feature prominently.

topics.title: Pashinyan sets repatriation as core goal of Armenia-diaspora ties
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan stated that the ultimate goal of Armenia-Diaspora relations is repatriation during meetings with Diaspora Commissioners and at the Third Global Armenian Summit. The summit opened with a formal ceremony in Yerevan, bringing together representatives from Armenian communities worldwide.

topics.title: Armenia advances toward EU visa-free travel and possible accession
topics.text: European Commissioner Marta Kos said Armenians are one step closer to visa-free travel to the EU, a point echoed by Armenian officials. Pashinyan indicated Armenia could apply to begin the EU accession process in 2027 or 2028, while the government approved signing agreements on participation in EU tax and customs programmes.

topics.title: Parliament discusses Shaki border incident; no systemic issue found
topics.text: The Armenian Parliament held a closed-door discussion on the Shaki incident involving an Azerbaijani serviceman. Officials, including Vilen Gabrielyan, stated the incident does not indicate a systemic border control problem and that Shaki residents were adequately informed.

topics.title: Businessman Samvel Karapetyan detained; opposition rallies in support
topics.text: Court remanded businessman Samvel Karapetyan into pre-trial detention for one month. Pashinyan cited Karapetyan as an example when calling for investigation into the wealth of "national benefactors." Opposition groups have rallied behind Karapetyan following his arrest.

topics.title: ANCA-endorsed candidates win in U.S. midterms; Azerbaijani lobbying falls short
topics.text: ANCA-endorsed candidates achieved significant victories in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, while Azerbaijani financial influence reportedly failed to sway outcomes. The results were reported by multiple Armenian diaspora outlets.

topics.title: Foreign Minister signals openness on Russian border guards and military base
topics.text: Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan expressed hope that Russian border guards will leave Armenia and stated Yerevan is not opposed to discussing the Russian military base. He also noted no specific agreements yet on reciprocal visits with Azerbaijani counterparts.

topics.title: Ararat-Armenia eliminated from Europa League; Armenian athletes compete internationally
topics.text: Ararat-Armenia lost their Europa League match in Portugal. Armenia will have one competitor at the World Weightlifting Championships on November 5, while footballer Eduard Spertsyan sustained an injury.
